posts.title: My Bluetooth app has a better user interface thanks to the Quick Setting Metric scorecard!
posts.description: Quick Settings Metric scores UX improvements I improved my Bluetooth app's UX by using the Quick Settings Metric . The score dropped from 16 all the way down to 1! The user went from "having to read a bunch of stuff and find a button and select something" to the common case of "the user has to press enter". posts.title: Your Bluetooth is bad, but it's not your fault
posts.description: Your Bluetooth is bad, but it's not your fault Or, making do with the chips you have Today's topic: sometimes a device's Bluetooth protocol is horrible, but the designers didn't have a choice. posts.title: Decoding the MEET MS-BDTP1A Multimeter Bluetooth
posts.description: Meet the MEET MS-BDTP1A multimeter! The MEET MS-BDTP1A multimeter is a cute battery-powered, very portable, pen-style multimeter. The maker has a handy web page with the full specs. This is my second successful multimeter; the previous one was the ANENG 9002 which has the BDM protocol described up on GitHub.
